zh: **做空 MNQ / NQ 对冲 QQQ，几乎等于“少拿一点 QQQ，其余放国库券”。** 扣除 QQQ 的 0.18% 管理费后，被对冲的部分每年赚国库券加大约 0 到 0.3 个点（2023 到 2025 年高利率时约 0.4 到 0.5），没有资金费率收入，没有固定的爆仓线，交易成本每年约为名义价值的 0.01%。
**它抬高了永续合约要过的门槛。** 配方 A 要在同样波动率下跑赢期货路线，资金费率在 2010 到 2026 年要高于约 3.4%，按最近三年的利率（国库券平均 4.45%）要高于约 7.9%；各交易所三个月的平均资金费率是 4.6% 到 7.5%，所以按最近三年的利率和最近的资金费率，期货路线略胜（按今天 4.04% 的国库券计算的门槛没有算）。
**它的代价是操作上的。** 要有能交易芝商所（CME）期货的美元保证金账户，合约粗（一张 MNQ 约 5.7 万美元），纳指上涨时每天要付现金，税务取决于居住地。2010 年以来最差的一个月，每 100 万美元现货、0.6 的对冲要付约 14.4 万美元；规模小时只能粗调。它不能对冲个股，也消除不了放在加密交易所的现货本身的托管风险。
en: **Shorting MNQ / NQ against QQQ is almost exactly "hold less QQQ and keep the rest in T-bills".** After QQQ's 0.18% fee the hedged part earns the T-bill rate plus roughly 0 to 0.3 points a year (about 0.4-0.5 in the high-rate years 2023-2025), with no funding income, no fixed wipe-out level, and trading costs of about 0.01% of notional a year.

**It raises the bar the perpetual has to clear.** For recipe A to beat the futures route at the same volatility, funding must exceed about 3.4% a year over 2010-2026 and about 7.9% at the last three years' rates (T-bills averaging 4.45%). The venues' three-month average funding was 4.6-7.5%, so at recent rates and recent funding the futures route edges ahead (the hurdle at today's 4.04% T-bill was not computed).

**Its costs are practical.** A USD margin account with access to CME futures, coarse contracts (about $57k per MNQ), cash paid out daily when the Nasdaq rises, and tax rules that depend on where you live. In the worst month since 2010 a 0.6 hedge paid out about $144k per $1M of spot, and small books can only size coarsely. It does not hedge single stocks, and it does not remove the custody risk of spot held on a crypto exchange.

zh.one_sentence: **一句话：** 现货 QQQ 不动，在期货账户里卖出纳斯达克 100 指数期货。指数涨，期货亏、现货赚；指数跌，反过来。卖出的那部分相当于把现货换成了国库券，再加一点期货价格里的融资利差。
differs: **没有固定的爆仓线，但亏损没有上限。** 期货每天逐日盯市：纳指上涨，亏损当天用现金付；下跌，收益当天入账。永续 2 倍逐仓在 TQQQ 一个月内涨约 46% 时清零；期货没有这条线，但空头要付完整的涨幅。
**追加保证金不到位，券商会强平。** IB 的风险披露写明：一般会在不事先通知、不让客户选择的情况下平仓以满足保证金要求。IBKR 会在证券和期货两部分之间转移多余现金，但“自动用 QQQ 的浮盈借钱付期货亏损”没有来源支持。要在期货账户里留足现金缓冲。
**没有交易所托管、自动减仓和下架风险，也没有资金费率收入。**

**成本可以忽略：** IBKR 一张 MNQ 每边约 0.62 美元（佣金 0.25 美元为 ProRealTime 通过 IBKR 的报价，交易所费用约 0.36 美元），加半个最小变动价位的滑点约 0.87 美元；一年四次展期约为名义价值的 0.012%（NQ 0.007%）。永续 0.06% 的吃单费单看手续费约是 MNQ 的 55 倍。期货和 QQQ 都随指数一比一变动，不需要像做空 TQQQ 那样每月重置。
**基差风险小，而且没有持续的溢价对你不利。** QQQ 总回报和期货之间的月度差异约 0.20% 到 0.32%，每日 0.19% 到 0.26%（部分是两个收盘时间不同）；永续在美东 16:00 平均比 TQQQ 收盘价高 0.32%。

routes.earns: 国库券加约 0 到 0.3 个点（扣 QQQ 管理费后；近年约 0.4 到 0.5）
routes.risks: 上涨时每天付现金，追加不到位被券商强平；每季度展期；合约规模粗；要另开账户
routes.suits: 不能卖或不想卖的人；可以随时加减的临时对冲；分散的、像纳指的组合

routes.earns: 约国库券加资金费率，减爆仓和交易所成本
routes.risks: 交易所 / USDT 托管、自动减仓（恰好在对冲起作用时）、下架、固定爆仓线（2 倍、2.5% 维持保证金时 TQQQ 一个月涨约 46%）、资金费率可能转负；中国居民的合规问题
routes.effort: 高：每月重置、续杯、留意分档
routes.suits: 只适合相信资金费率会稳定高于门槛（按最近三年利率约 8%）并接受交易所风险的人

routes.risks: SQQQ 有磨损；期权有时间价值损耗

zh.route4_numbers: 第 4 条的数字：买相当于现货 0.20 的 SQQQ 年化 5.9%（比同波动率组合少 1.6），0.33 为 −0.7%（少 5.2）。芝加哥期权交易所的标普 500 保护性认沽指数（PPUT）2010 到 2026 年年化 10.57%，标普 500 总回报 14.14%；长期窗口里每年落后 2.8 到 3.6 个点，最近三年落后 5.0；但相对同样波动率的标普加国库券组合（10.9%）只少约 0.3，最大回撤 −22.1%（指数 −33.8%，组合 −25.5%）。纳指认沽隐含波动率更高，会更贵，但没有测算。
zh.single_stocks: **个股不在此列。** 用 QQQ 或 NQ 对冲单只大型科技股，样本外只能降低 18% 到 42% 的日波动（TSLA 18%、META 27%、AVGO 31%、GOOGL 和 AMZN 35%、NVDA 36%、AAPL 38%、MSFT 42%），最大回撤的变化在 −9 到 +13 个点之间，没有规律，有时更差（MSFT 从 −37% 变成 −46%）。8 只大型股的等权组合则去掉约 69% 的波动，最大回撤从 −46% 减半到 −22%。2023 年以来，QQQ 对 MSFT、AAPL、GOOGL、AMZN、META 日涨跌的解释力比 2016 到 2019 年和 2020 到 2022 年都低。DEEP_DIVE 里“NVDA / MSFT / AVGO / TSLA 在任何设置下都输”那几行，指数期货同样解决不了。
who: **能卖、卖出不产生税（例如一般情况下的新加坡个人投资者）：** 卖出部分 QQQ，持有国库券。结果和期货几乎一样，工作最少。
**卖出会产生税、现货不能卖（锁定期、员工持股）、或者想做可以随时加减的临时对冲：** 期货。前提是组合像纳指一样分散，并且在期货账户里留足现金缓冲。一次 MNQ 开平的手续费约为名义价值的 0.003%。
**永续：** 只有在你认为资金费率会长期高于门槛（2010 到 2026 年约 3.4%，按最近三年利率约 7.9%），并接受交易所、自动减仓、下架和托管风险时才有意义。按最近的利率和 4.6% 到 7.5% 的三个月平均资金费率，它不如期货。
**想要亏损有上限、不想面对追加保证金：** 认沽期权，代价是每年几个点。
**持有的是单只股票：** 任何指数对冲都只能去掉一小部分风险；卖出一部分才是真正降低风险的办法。
zh.custody: **换成期货不会消除现货本身的“交易所风险”。** 如果现货放在加密交易所，期货只把对冲腿的自动减仓、下架、爆仓线和托管风险拿走，现货的托管还在原处。如果现货是 xStocks 的 QQQx 这类代币，持有人没有股东权利，只能通过发行方 Backed 赎回（另收费用；二手资料说可能只对合格投资者或有最低金额）。两条腿分在两个地方还会产生新问题：上涨时期货在券商那里亏现金，而浮盈在加密交易所，卖出再电汇要几天。这些投资人的现货是代币还是券商账户里的 ETF，材料里没有说明。

sg: 期货属于“指定投资产品”，经纪商开通前要做客户账户审核（CAR）；这一点来自券商的常见问题页面，SGX 原页面没有读到。IBKR 新加坡受新加坡金管局监管是工作组的说法，执照页面没有核对。
新加坡一般不对股票和金融工具的买卖收益征税（IRAS）；如果被认定为以交易为业（“交易标志”，只有二手资料），收益可能作为收入征税，这一判断对期货和永续可能一样适用。
QQQ 的股息被美国预扣 30%（两国没有税收协定，IRS 表 3），被对冲部分每年约少 0.13 个点。
境外加密衍生品平台“在金管局的监管之外”（金管局 2020 年国会答复），投资人在永续路线上没有新加坡的保护。
非美国人持有美国资产可能涉及美国遗产税：未核实。
tax.cn_head: 中国大陆居民（最不确定的部分）
cn: IBKR 自 2025 年起收紧大陆居民开户：新客户要提供大陆身份证件和境外居住或工作证明（第一财经）。
个人每年 5 万美元的购汇额度（国家外汇管理局 2007 年页面）；这一额度不能用于境外证券投资的说法只来自 2017 年的报道，未核实。
境外投资收益按全年已实现盈亏的净额征税（财新，北京税务热线确认）；20% 的税率在财新页面上只出现在标注“仅供参考”的 AI 摘要里，应以个人所得税法原文核对。财新称自 2024 年年中起借助 CRS 加强执法。期货收益如何归类没有确认。
QQQ 股息按中美协定预扣 10%（IRS 表 1），每年约少 0.045 个点。
对永续路线更不利：银发〔2026〕42 号（八部门，2026-02-06，取代 237 号）重申虚拟货币相关业务属于非法金融活动；USDT 保证金的股票永续是否在其范围内没有确认，但显然处在这些规定针对的领域。
tax.us: **美国人（简述）**：NQ / MNQ 是第 1256 条合约，年底按市值计价，收益 60% 按长期、40% 按短期；持有 QQQ 同时做空指数期货“很可能”构成第 1092 条的混合跨式，这是工作组自己的判断，没有来源直接这样说；财政部条例 1.1092(b)-6 例 3 有指数基金加反向指数期货选择为“已识别混合跨式”的例子；表 6781 的 A 框（混合跨式选择）和 B 框（逐笔跨式识别选择）会改变结果；第 1259 条（推定出售）是否适用，取决于指数期货是否算 QQQ 的“实质相同财产”，没有找到答案，而且现金交割的指数期货能否算“交付”QQQ 的合约本身就有疑问。请咨询税务顾问。

en.one_sentence: **In one sentence:** keep the QQQ, and in a futures account sell Nasdaq-100 index futures. When the index rises the futures lose and the spot gains; when it falls, the reverse. The part you sell works like swapping spot for T-bills, plus a small financing spread built into the futures price.
differs: **No fixed wipe-out level, but no cap on the loss.** Futures are marked to market daily: a Nasdaq rise is paid in cash that day, a fall is credited. The perpetual at 2x isolated margin is wiped out if TQQQ rises about 46% within a month; futures have no such line, but the short pays the whole rally.

**If a margin call is not met, the broker closes the position.** IB's risk disclosure says it generally liquidates to meet margin requirements without prior notice and without letting the client choose. IBKR moves excess cash between its securities and futures segments, but no source supports "it will automatically borrow against the QQQ gain to pay the futures loss". Keep a cash buffer in the futures account.
**No exchange custody, auto-deleveraging or delisting risk, and no funding income.**

**Costs are negligible:** about $0.62 per MNQ per side at IBKR (a $0.25 commission as ProRealTime quotes it through IBKR, plus about $0.36 of exchange fees), $0.87 with half a tick of slippage; four rolls a year come to 0.012% of notional (NQ 0.007%). On fees alone, the perpetual's 0.06% taker fee is about 55 times the MNQ cost per side. Futures and QQQ both move one-for-one with the index, so there is no monthly reset as with a TQQQ short.

**Basis risk is small and has no persistent premium against you.** The gap between QQQ total return and the futures varies by about 0.20-0.32% a month and 0.19-0.26% a day (partly because the two closes are taken at different times); the perpetual closes on average 0.32% above TQQQ at 16:00 ET.

routes.risks: tax on the sale (generally none in Singapore)

routes.earns: T-bills plus roughly 0-0.3 points (after QQQ's fee; about 0.4-0.5 lately)
routes.risks: daily cash in rallies, broker close-out if a call is not met; quarterly rolls; coarse contract size; a second account
routes.suits: those who cannot or will not sell; hedges put on and taken off; diversified Nasdaq-like books

routes.earns: about T-bills plus funding, minus liquidation and venue costs
routes.risks: exchange / USDT custody, auto-deleveraging (just when the hedge works), delisting, a fixed wipe-out level (TQQQ +46% within a month at 2x and 2.5% maintenance), funding that can turn negative; legality for PRC residents
routes.effort: high: monthly resets, refills, watching tiers
routes.suits: only those who expect funding to stay above the hurdle (about 8% at the last three years' rates) and accept venue risk
those who want a capped loss with no margin calls

en.route4_numbers: Route 4 in numbers: SQQQ worth 0.20 of spot returned 5.9% a year (1.6 below its same-volatility mix), worth 0.33 -0.7% (5.2 below). Cboe's S&P 500 protective-put index (PPUT) returned 10.57% a year over 2010-2026 against 14.14% for the S&P 500 total return: 2.8-3.6 points a year behind over long windows and 5.0 over the last three years, but only about 0.3 behind a same-volatility S&P + T-bill mix (10.9%), with a worst fall of -22.1% (index -33.8%, mix -25.5%). Nasdaq-100 puts carry higher implied volatility and would cost more; that was not measured.
en.single_stocks: **Single stocks are a different case.** Hedging one big tech stock with QQQ or NQ cut its daily volatility, out of sample, by only 18-42% (TSLA 18%, META 27%, AVGO 31%, GOOGL and AMZN 35%, NVDA 36%, AAPL 38%, MSFT 42%), and changed the worst fall unpredictably, by -9 to +13 points, sometimes for the worse (MSFT from -37% to -46%). An equal-weight basket of eight megacaps lost about 69% of its volatility and saw its worst fall halve, from -46% to -22%. Since 2023 QQQ explains less of MSFT's, AAPL's, GOOGL's, AMZN's and META's daily moves than in either 2016-2019 or 2020-2022. DEEP_DIVE's single-stock lines (NVDA / MSFT / AVGO / TSLA lose at every setting) would not be fixed by index futures either.
who: **You can sell, and selling costs no tax (for example, Singapore individuals in general):** sell some QQQ and hold T-bills. Nearly the same result as futures, with the least work.

**Selling triggers tax, the spot cannot be sold (lock-up, employee stock), or you want a hedge you can put on and take off:** futures, provided the book is diversified and Nasdaq-like and you keep a cash buffer in the futures account. One MNQ on-and-off round trip costs about 0.003% of notional.

**The perpetual:** only if you believe funding will stay above the hurdle (about 3.4% over 2010-2026, about 7.9% at the last three years' rates) and accept exchange, auto-deleveraging, delisting and custody risk. At recent rates and the 4.6-7.5% three-month average funding it falls short of futures.
**You want a capped loss and no margin calls:** puts, at a cost of a few points a year.
**You hold a single stock:** no index hedge removes more than a minority of its risk; selling part of it is what reduces risk.
en.custody: **Switching to futures does not remove the exchange risk on the spot.** If the spot sits on a crypto exchange, futures take auto-deleveraging, delisting, the wipe-out level and perpetual custody off the hedge leg only; the spot's custody stays where it is. If the spot is a token such as xStocks' QQQx, the holder has no shareholder rights, only redemption through the issuer, Backed (for a fee; secondary sources say possibly only for qualified investors or above a minimum size). Splitting the legs also creates a new problem: in a rally the futures lose cash at the broker while the gains sit on the crypto exchange, and selling and wiring takes days. Whether these investors hold a token or a brokerage ETF is not stated in the material.

sg: Futures are Specified Investment Products: the broker must run a Customer Account Review (CAR) before enabling them. This rests on broker FAQs; the SGX page itself was not read. That IBKR Singapore is MAS-regulated is the workstream's statement; its licence page was not checked.

Gains on shares and financial instruments are generally not taxable in Singapore (IRAS); if the activity is judged a trade (the "badges of trade", secondary sources only) gains can be taxed as income, a test that probably applies to futures and perpetuals alike.
QQQ dividends lose 30% to US withholding (no US treaty, IRS Table 3): about 0.13 points a year on the hedged amount.
Offshore crypto-derivative platforms are "outside of MAS' regulatory oversight" (MAS parliamentary reply, 2020): no Singapore protection on the perpetual route.
US estate tax on US-listed assets held by non-US persons: unverified.
tax.cn_head: Mainland China residents (the least certain part)
cn: IBKR has tightened account opening for mainland residents since 2025: new clients must show a mainland ID and proof of overseas residence or employment (Yicai).
The individual FX purchase quota is USD 50,000 a year (SAFE, 2007 page); that it may not be used for overseas securities rests only on 2017 reporting and is unverified.

Overseas investment gains are taxed on net realised gains for the whole year (Caixin, confirmed by the Beijing tax hotline). The 20% rate appears on Caixin's page only in an AI digest marked "for reference only"; check it against the Individual Income Tax Law. Caixin reports enforcement rising since mid-2024 with CRS data. How futures gains are classified was not confirmed.
QQQ dividends lose 10% under the US-China treaty (IRS Table 1): about 0.045 points a year.

The perpetual route is worse: notice 银发〔2026〕42号 (eight agencies, 2026-02-06, replacing 237号) restates that virtual-currency business is illegal financial activity. Whether a USDT-margined stock perpetual falls under it was not confirmed, but it plainly sits in the area the rules target.
tax.us: **US persons, briefly:** NQ / MNQ are Section 1256 contracts, marked to market at year end, gains 60% long-term and 40% short-term. That long QQQ against short index futures is "very likely" a Section 1092 mixed straddle is the workstream's own judgment; no source says so directly. Treas. Reg. 1.1092(b)-6, Example 3, shows index-fund shares and a short index future elected as an identified mixed straddle; Form 6781 boxes A (mixed straddle election) and B (straddle-by-straddle identification election) change the result. Whether Section 1259 (constructive sale) applies turns on whether an index future is "substantially identical" to QQQ, which no source resolved; a cash-settled index future is arguably not a contract "to deliver" QQQ at all. Ask a tax adviser.
